items.html: Even if it seems right to explain that the male drop is the first forty-two, Yod-Hey-Vav of the Heys as mentioned above, and the two drops are female, even though they are twice forty-two, nevertheless in their simple form they are only Ehyeh twice, which in gematria are forty-two alone. And these two times forty-two are the forty-two doubled couplings that were sown in the holy covenant of Arich.
